faq.q: Which media is the system designed for?
faq.a: For drinking water, hot and cold, with high temperature and pressure resistance over decades. Due to PP's resistance to solvents, alkalis, and acids, industrial applications are also possible; we verify these on a project-specific basis with you.

faq.q: What do the five SDR classes stand for?
faq.a: SDR is the ratio of outer diameter to wall thickness (d/s). Smaller SDR = thicker wall = higher nominal pressure: SDR 6 corresponds to PN 20, SDR 17 corresponds to PN 6. This way you choose exactly the reserve you need per application, without over-dimensioning.

Monolayer is the economical standard for most applications. The glass fiber reinforced composite reduces thermal expansion to about a quarter, allows larger clamp distances, and remains dimensionally stable for large dimensions and hot water, the choice for risers, circulation, and d ≥ 160.

Material-bonded by welding, manual socket welding (up to d63) or by machine, electrofusion via heating coil fittings, and butt welding for large dimensions up to d630. The suitable devices and tools are part of the programme; all four methods are shown in the Academy video.

faq.q: Is the system compliant for drinking water?
faq.a: The system is developed for drinking water; polypropylene is tasteless and odorless. We provide the conformity proofs for drinking water contact (DVGW/KTW) in the Trust Centre as part of the RFP document package.

faq.q: What lifespan is the design based on?
faq.a: The pressure ratings are based on the creep regression curves of DIN 8077/8078 with a design horizon of 50 years of operation, including safety factor. The two programme anchors: SDR 6 with 20 bar at 20 °C and PPRCT SDR 7.4 with 10 bar at 70 °C.

faq.q: How long are the ISO certificates valid?
faq.a: Three years, the current cycle runs from 10/2025 to 10/2028, accompanied by annual surveillance audits by the certification company.
The German Accreditation Body (DAkkS) is the national accreditation body of Germany. It monitors the certification companies itself, the accreditation makes the certificate internationally resilient.

faq.q: How do I verify a certificate?
faq.a: Every certificate has a certificate number (e.g. Q-2025-6732) and the issuing body. With both details, the validity can be checked directly with the certification company, or you can inquire at support@k-aqua.de.

faq.q: Are there Scope 3 and EPD raw data?
faq.a: Yes, we provide Scope 3 emission data and EPD raw data on request. Proactive transparency instead of fulfilling a duty: your sustainability team gets reliable figures for its own balance sheet.

faq.q: Do you provide GAEB specification texts?
faq.a: Yes, GAEB texts are part of the RFP document package. This allows the K Aqua system to migrate smoothly into your AVA software and bills of quantities.

faq.q: What is an EPD according to EN 15804?
faq.a: An Environmental Product Declaration (Type III) with verified life cycle assessment data over the life cycle. It is the data basis for building certifications such as LEED, BREEAM and DGNB, and for CO₂-adjusted procurement models.
